description: List a repository's flaky tests. A test is flaky only with a forensic repro: when it failed, CI re-ran just that test in the same order, alone, with the clock shifted +137 ms and +1 s, in TZ=Pacific/Chatham and in a fixed random order, and a variable flipped its verdict N times in a row on the same git tree. Each entry has the test, file, state (active / expired / resolved, or unexplained = flipped with no repro, NOT flaky), label (clock-dependent, order-dependent, concurrency-dependent), the variable, the exact repro command, owner, expiry, issue number, flip rate and evidence runs. Information only — flaky tests are never skipped or quarantined; one targeted retry, and the merge gate excuses a failure only when that retry passed in the same run and the label is active.

window_days.description: Flip evidence from this many days back (default and max 30)

name: gluecron_list_flaky_tests
